{{short description|Asymptotic estimate in group theory}}
In [[finite group|finite group theory]], the '''Higman–Sims asymptotic formula''' gives an asymptotic estimate on number of groups of prime power order.

==Statement==
Let <math>p</math> be a (fixed) [[prime number]]. Define <math>f(n,p)</math> as the number of isomorphism classes of groups of order <math>p^n</math>. Then:
:<math>f(n,p) = p^{\frac{2}{27}n^3 + \mathcal O(n^{8/3})}</math>
Here, the [[big-O notation]] is with respect to <math>n</math>,  not with respect to <math>p</math> (the constant under the big-O notation may depend on <math>p</math>).
